status_label: Official preliminary update — field validation continues

source.title: [Update]: M7.7 NTT earthquake — emergency response and validated field update

confirmed: 1 confirmed death in Sikka Regency and 4 injured people in Sikka and Nagekeo.
Approximately 2,000 residents in Nagekeo undertook self-evacuation.
1 household (6 people) was reported affected in Bima City.
The tsunami warning ended at 07:31:30 WIB; aftershock vigilance remains necessary.
damage_reports: 2 houses heavily damaged, 1 moderately damaged and 2 slightly damaged.
3 public facilities slightly damaged and 6 government offices affected.
Electricity remained disrupted in Nagekeo at the time of the BNPB update.
information_gaps: Consolidated numbers displaced, missing and affected by district.
Verified building damage by location and severity.
Operational status of hospitals, health centres, water and telecommunications.
Comprehensive status of roads, bridges, ports and airports.
disclaimer: All figures remain preliminary and may change following further verification and validation by BNPB, BPBD and relevant authorities.
